facts.fact: Starlink had 66,523 subscribers in Nigeria as of Q2 2025 per industry data cited by Africa Innovation Watch (not a regulator count); average download about 49.6 Mbps.

Starlink suspended sales and activations nationwide in November 2024 over bandwidth shortages and tariff disputes with the NCC, which sanctioned it in October 2024 for adjusting tariffs without approval.
Starlink nationwide sales resumed in July 2025.
Starlink halted new orders in parts of Lagos and Abuja from late September 2025 for lack of capacity, and by 12 January 2026 showed Sold Out across all of Lagos and Abuja with deposit waitlists.
